title: Fees and payments guidance for families
content_markdown:
## Guidance for parents and families

RMIT explains that enrolment creates a responsibility for students to monitor tuition information, payment due dates, and financial obligations. Students can view semester charges, overdue fees, and any credit balance through the Financial Account tile in myRMIT. Official fee notices and invoices are sent to the student through university channels, so parents should coordinate with the student. A student may authorise a third party such as a parent to pay tuition and share the necessary billing details. The normal payment deadline is 9 pm Vietnam time on Friday of week 3, while block and intensive postgraduate courses follow special deadlines. Medical-insurance charges appear on the tuition invoice and evidence is required when a student seeks the applicable insurance waiver. Student Connect provides support for fee questions.
